scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,ml -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:dev" "npm run ml:dev"
scripts.test: npm run lint -w client && npm run build -w client && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: npm run seed:test -w server && cross-env-shell "PORT=${PORT:-5010} SMOKE_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-5010}/api/v1 WAIT_ON_TIMEOUT=120000 start-server-and-test \"npm run server:start\" http-get://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-5010}/api/v1/system/health \"npm run smoke -w server\""
scripts.server:dev: cross-env MONGO_MEMORY_FALLBACK=true npm run dev -w server
scripts.server:start: cross-env MONGO_MEMORY_FALLBACK=true npm run start -w server
